adminToken.description: A DPoP-bound access token (RFC 9449 §7.1), presented with a DPoP proof header. Token calls are not subject to the CSRF check and are subject to the proof instead.

consoleSession.description: The first-party session cookie (ADR-0009). Every state-changing request must also carry X-CSRF-Token, whose value is the `csrf_token` of GET /admin/api/v1/session.
consoleSession.name: __Host-asterius_session

info.description: The first-party administration API. Two authentication modes: the console, which is a same-origin application holding the IdP session cookie and no OAuth token of any kind (ADR-0009); and automation, which holds a DPoP-bound access token. Every operation declares the authority it requires in x-asterius-reach and x-asterius-scope, taken from the same declaration the router enforces. State-changing operations are never mounted on GET: SameSite=Lax does not protect a top-level GET, so the registry's types make a mutating GET unexpressible.
info.title: Asterius Admin API
